phase: Phase 1B — packet instance schema. Additive extension of the Phase 1A packet-schema (does not modify it): adds the lifecycle partition + partition-conditional pipeline for the finite-investigation closing model (Amendment 002).
base: docs/halo/contract/phase1/packet-schema.json (5-12 IDs, one module, two-delta, inherited stops)

authority_binding.note: Pins the exact per-metric semantic binding artifact. ref MUST equal the packet-specific canonical binding path DERIVED from packet_id (PKT-XX-YY -> docs/halo/contract/phase1b/pkt-xx-yy-binding.json), enforced by the packet validator; sha256 MUST be a lowercase 64-hex digest matching that binding file. Each metric def must EQUAL its binding record field-for-field.

invariants: module is one frozen integer 1..11; every target_id is owned by module per the frozen 295->11 map.
5 <= len(target_ids) <= 12 (or size_reason present); target_ids unique; == this packet's assignment in packet-index.json.
lifecycle_partition's five id-sets are pairwise disjoint and their union == target_ids.
source_investigation_pending_ids and accepted_disposition_only_ids are disjoint (SIP is NEVER accepted_disposition_only).

each accepted_disposition_only id has an evidence-backed terminal/allowed disposition (external_source_required / additional_history_required / genuinely_not_available / outside_sales_domain), never source_investigation_pending.
each source_dependencies[i] references a registered source_id (single fan-out; no per-packet reacquisition) and is labelled reuse vs fresh_acquisition.

PIPELINE (partition-conditional): only accepted_measured_ids may carry value/baseline/grade/narrative/customer-mini-report; accepted_disposition_only appears only in safe appendix/internal companion (ID+label, no value); rejected has no customer projection; source_investigation_pending/calculation_pending are open (no value/grade/narrative/customer projection).
open ids block only this module + final completion; they never block unrelated packets.
stop_conditions.inherited_canonical equals the Phase 1A canonical fail-closed stop names; two_delta_proof requires both deltas.
metric_definitions (when status=active_authored) each validate against the Phase 1A metric_row schema.

authority_binding.ref MUST equal the binding path derived from packet_id: PKT-XX-YY -> docs/halo/contract/phase1b/pkt-xx-yy-binding.json (lowercased); the validator derives and enforces this equality (not any-path acceptance).
authority_binding.sha256 MUST equal the sha256 of the derived binding file.
supersedes_for_new_packets: docs/halo/contract/phase1b/packet-schema-1b.json (v1 frozen; NOT edited). Additive: identical to v1 except authority_binding.ref is packet-specific (v1 hard-coded PKT-02-01's binding path). Retains ALL frozen requirements.
